# Handoff Acknowledged

## Summary

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS |
|--------|---------------|-----------|
| tuning_mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| tuning_min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| lockbox_mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| lockbox_min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| worst_mdd | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

**Champion holds.** Better tuning consistency and tighter drawdown control outweigh the marginal lockbox_min improvement from the candidate.

## Status
- ✅ Runloop healthy — 214 iterations, ~25h remaining
- ✅ No INCONCLUSIVE candidates pending
- ✅ No blocking issues

## Recommended Actions

Execute the three queued commands in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Module-level best selection
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. System-level candidate sweep
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate diagnostics for next iteration
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- `tuning_min` on PASS candidate was dangerously low (0.05) — indicates fragility in at least one fold
- Consider investigating fold-level variance if next candidates show similar spread

Ready to continue loop or escalate if anomalies appear.
